doc.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997

chapter: Personal life and the future of jazz
title: Next gig in Ames and goodbyes
summary: Moore names his upcoming concert in Ames with Warren Vache and Gene, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Lot of food for thought there. Speaking of food—
Where are you off to next?
Let’s see, Ames, Iowa this week, with Warren Vache and Gene. We’re doing a concert there. We did one last year. It takes us a long time to get there, but it’s fun once we’re there.
Well it’s been a great pleasure for me.
Well, Monk, it’s been a real pleasure talking to you too.
So on behalf of the college, I’d like to thank you for your time, and I hope that you have a good gig tonight and that no one throws tunes your way that you don’t know.
Well I mean at this point, it’s been happening to me since I was 15. I ought to be used to it by now.
All right. Good afternoon to you.
